user_stories.title: Add deferred cleanup for stdout and stderr pipes in runner.Run()
acceptance_criteria: defer stdout.Close() is added immediately after cmd.StdoutPipe() call (after line 1070)
defer stderr.Close() is added immediately after cmd.StderrPipe() call (after line 1074)
All existing tests pass: go test ./internal/runner/...
No race conditions detected: go test -race ./internal/runner/...
user_stories.notes: This is a minimal, surgical fix adding exactly 2 lines of code. The defer statements ensure pipes are closed on all execution paths, preventing file descriptor leaks when cmd.Start() fails or other errors occur after pipe creation.
